summary: JX Luxventure Group Inc., a Marshall Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on September 21, 2026 its board, acting by unanimous written consent, and majority shareholders holding 7,554,888 common shares plus all Series A, C and D convertible preferred stock, representing roughly 63% of voting capital, approved Amendment #1 to the 2026 Equity Incentive Plan. The amendment raises the share reserve from 4,500,000 to 9,300,000 common shares, subject to customary anti-dilution adjustments. No transaction, price, premium, advisor or regulatory clock is stated; watch potential dilution overhang from the enlarged plan.
